title: Added industry-aware model inputs and common query surfaces
points: Added industry-family model input views for banks, cement, energy, fertilizer, pharma/consumer, textile/industrial, and technology so model and valuation retrieval can start from sector-appropriate input bundles.
Added deterministic input surfaces for common user asks: latest market snapshots, valuation numerator/denominator inputs, net-cash screens, and growth-screen inputs.

Updated the financial-statement lane contract to prefer these views before raw statement SQL, preserving the rule that P/E uses market cap divided by annual net profit rather than EPS or historical shares.
